hooks.prompt: The agent wants to run '$ARGUMENTS'. If this command includes command substitution for capturing text (e.g. `git commit -m "$(cat.."`), respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "DO NOT use command substitution when capturing text. Use a different approach, like just in-lining the text."}.

The agent wants to run: $ARGUMENTS. If this command uses grep, sed, or awk to search or read files, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Use the built-in Grep, Glob, and Read tools instead of shell grep/sed/awk. They are more context-efficient."} If the command is fine or uses grep/sed as part of a pipeline where native tools wouldn't work, respond {"ok": true}.

The agent wants to run: $ARGUMENTS. If this command tries to use temporary directories, like '/tmp' or '/private', respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Use a directory in the current worktree called '.tmp'. If this directory isn't already in the '.gitignore' file, add it."}.
